note: Kentucky State Parks campground beside the Kentucky River at Fort Boonesborough, near Richmond: three loops of paved back-in sites, full hookups at sites 1-10 among others. The outer sites of the northeast loop look at the river through a tree band from about 9 m above; none is on the bank. Sites 146 and 147 take rigs only to about 20 ft. Reconstructed fort, pool and boat ramp in the park. --Claude
